content: 第五关（前）

speaker: Crownslayer
content: Mephisto?

raw: [name="???"]    You have no reason to object, right? Just a few insects that flew too close to the light... are they really worth your time?
content: You have no reason to object, right? Just a few insects that flew too close to the light... are they really worth your time?

raw: [name="???"]    My troops have already received your info. You've already done your part.
content: My troops have already received your info. You've already done your part.

raw: [name="???"]    All that's left for you to do is to go home. After all, you're just responsible for the core energy sector and its surroundings...
content: All that's left for you to do is to go home. After all, you're just responsible for the core energy sector and its surroundings...

speaker: Crownslayer
content: Don't do anything unnecessary...!

raw: [name="???"]    You still have somewhere else to be, don't you?
content: You still have somewhere else to be, don't you?

speaker: Crownslayer
content: Fine. Have it your way.

raw: [name="Crownslayer"]    I can't wait to see you fail.
speaker: Crownslayer
content: I can't wait to see you fail.

speaker: Crownslayer
content: We're leaving.

raw: [name="Amiya"]    One of the enemy leaders... just took a portion of the Reunion troops and left?
speaker: Amiya
content: One of the enemy leaders... just took a portion of the Reunion troops and left?

speaker: Dobermann
content: What are they up to?

raw: [name="Dobermann"]    Whatever it is, we can't let our guard down... The enemy is still many times our size!
speaker: Dobermann
content: Whatever it is, we can't let our guard down... The enemy is still many times our size!

raw: [name="???"]    Well, well. Please allow me to apologize on Crownslayer's behalf for her rudeness.
content: Well, well. Please allow me to apologize on Crownslayer's behalf for her rudeness.

speaker: Mephisto
content: You can call me Mephisto.

raw: [name="Dobermann"]    What is Reunion trying to accomplish?
speaker: Dobermann
content: What is Reunion trying to accomplish?

raw: [name="Mephisto"]    Oh, nothing in particular. To be honest, I wouldn't even mind letting you bunch go. You weren't even our targets in the first place.
speaker: Mephisto
content: Oh, nothing in particular. To be honest, I wouldn't even mind letting you bunch go. You weren't even our targets in the first place.

raw: [name="Amiya"]    If we weren't your targets, then why...
speaker: Amiya
content: If we weren't your targets, then why...

raw: [name="Mephisto"]    However, I had the honor of watching your battles.
speaker: Mephisto
content: However, I had the honor of watching your battles.

raw: [name="Mephisto"]    Your combat tactics as well as your personnel configuration were quite intriguing.
speaker: Mephisto
content: Your combat tactics as well as your personnel configuration were quite intriguing.

speaker: Medic
content: ...Intriguing?

raw: [name="Medic"]    You think that the carnage of battle is... intriguing?
speaker: Medic
content: You think that the carnage of battle is... intriguing?

raw: [name="Mephisto"]    Rhodes Island... I've read up on your group before.
speaker: Mephisto
content: Rhodes Island... I've read up on your group before.

raw: [name="Mephisto"]    At first, I thought you were just another ordinary company.
speaker: Mephisto
content: At first, I thought you were just another ordinary company.

raw: [name="Mephisto"]    But by the looks of things, don't you think your ambitions have stretched a bit too far from playing with test tubes?
speaker: Mephisto
content: But by the looks of things, don't you think your ambitions have stretched a bit too far from playing with test tubes?

raw: [name="Mephisto"]    It'd be terribly dull if I allowed you to just walk out of here, wouldn't it?
speaker: Mephisto
content: It'd be terribly dull if I allowed you to just walk out of here, wouldn't it?

raw: [name="Mephisto"]    What I'd like is to have a little competition, a ritual of sorts.
speaker: Mephisto
content: What I'd like is to have a little competition, a ritual of sorts.

raw: [name="Dobermann"]    ...We don't have time to waste on a preoperational kid.
speaker: Dobermann
content: ...We don't have time to waste on a preoperational kid.

raw: [name="Dobermann"]    (Amiya, get ready. We might have to break through with force.)
speaker: Dobermann
content: (Amiya, get ready. We might have to break through with force.)

speaker: Dobermann
content: (I'll get his attention...!)

speaker: Amiya
content: (Mm, okay!)

raw: [name="Mephisto"]    ...What was that just now? Who were you sending a signal to?
speaker: Mephisto
content: ...What was that just now? Who were you sending a signal to?

speaker: Dobermann
content: None of your business, kid.

speaker: Dobermann
content: (Amiya?)

raw: [name="Mephisto"]    Come on, we're all professionals here. Where's your basic courtesy?
speaker: Mephisto
content: Come on, we're all professionals here. Where's your basic courtesy?

raw: [name="Dobermann"]    If people like you didn't exist, I wouldn't have to constantly be honing my insults!
speaker: Dobermann
content: If people like you didn't exist, I wouldn't have to constantly be honing my insults!

speaker: Dobermann
content: (Amiya, what's going on?)

raw: [name="Amiya"]    (Dobermann... All of our escape routes have been blocked by his troops!)
speaker: Amiya
content: (Dobermann... All of our escape routes have been blocked by his troops!)

raw: [name="Dobermann"]    (How can that be?! How did he manage to do that in just a few minutes--)
speaker: Dobermann
content: (How can that be?! How did he manage to do that in just a few minutes--)

speaker: Mephisto
content: This simply won't do.

raw: [name="Mephisto"]    Even though I gave you my sincere invitation...
speaker: Mephisto
content: Even though I gave you my sincere invitation...

raw: [name="Mephisto"]    But all you can think of...
speaker: Mephisto
content: But all you can think of...

speaker: Mephisto
content: ...is running away?!

speaker: Dobermann
content: Tsk...!

raw: [name="Mephisto"]    Actually, I'll let you leave my hunting grounds safely as long as you win.
speaker: Mephisto
content: Actually, I'll let you leave my hunting grounds safely as long as you win.

raw: [name="Mephisto"]    Until then, my friends here will keep trying to kill you.
speaker: Mephisto
content: Until then, my friends here will keep trying to kill you.

raw: [name="Mephisto"]    It's your victory as long as you don't die! The rules are simple enough, right?
speaker: Mephisto
content: It's your victory as long as you don't die! The rules are simple enough, right?

speaker: Dobermann
content: Ace!

raw: [name="Ace"]    We're already prepared to break through.
speaker: Ace
content: We're already prepared to break through.

raw: [name="Ace"]    But we have to stave off their attacks first!
speaker: Ace
content: But we have to stave off their attacks first!

raw: [name="Amiya"]    Why are you doing this? The Catastrophe is coming! If we don't leave Chernobog, then everyone will--
speaker: Amiya
content: Why are you doing this? The Catastrophe is coming! If we don't leave Chernobog, then everyone will--

speaker: Mephisto
content: What are you talking about...

raw: [name="Mephisto"]    The Catastrophe... makes it the best time to celebrate.
speaker: Mephisto
content: The Catastrophe... makes it the best time to celebrate.

speaker: Amiya
content: You're sick...

raw: [name="Mephisto"]    My esteemed guests, I am honored to invite you to this game.
speaker: Mephisto
content: My esteemed guests, I am honored to invite you to this game.

speaker: Reunion Member
content: Argh... Argh...!

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]    Kill... Kill! ! Kill... them all!!
speaker: Reunion Member
content: Kill... Kill! ! Kill... them all!!

speaker: Dobermann
content: Amiya! Watch out!

speaker: Mephisto
content: Right, right...

raw: [name="Mephisto"]    Actually, we know exactly what you did in the central area.
speaker: Mephisto
content: Actually, we know exactly what you did in the central area.

raw: [name="Mephisto"]    That masked person you rescued... makes me very, very curious.
speaker: Mephisto
content: That masked person you rescued... makes me very, very curious.

raw: [name="Mephisto"]    Crownslayer is so fixated on what you're going to do next, where you're going to go.
speaker: Mephisto
content: Crownslayer is so fixated on what you're going to do next, where you're going to go.

raw: [name="Mephisto"]    But I'm different. What I care about is...
speaker: Mephisto
content: But I'm different. What I care about is...

raw: [name="Mephisto"]    What exactly are you? Where are you from?
speaker: Mephisto
content: What exactly are you? Where are you from?

raw: [name="Mephisto"]    Yes, you. The one staring at me right now... You are somewhat different from us.
speaker: Mephisto
content: Yes, you. The one staring at me right now... You are somewhat different from us.

raw: [name="Mephisto"]    What was the device in that facility that was able to preserve your life?
speaker: Mephisto
content: What was the device in that facility that was able to preserve your life?

speaker: Mephisto
content: I am so, very curious.

raw: [name="Mephisto"]    See, I'm not such a cold-blooded person...
speaker: Mephisto
content: See, I'm not such a cold-blooded person...

raw: [name="Mephisto"]    So how about it, my esteemed Rhodes Island guests, how about giving this person to me as a gift?
speaker: Mephisto
content: So how about it, my esteemed Rhodes Island guests, how about giving this person to me as a gift?

raw: [name="Mephisto"]    It would be a shame to end the game early, but at least I'll let the rest of you go. How about it?
speaker: Mephisto
content: It would be a shame to end the game early, but at least I'll let the rest of you go. How about it?

speaker: Amiya
content: Doctor...

speaker: Amiya
content: Get behind me!!
